title: Agent Certificate v0 Pre-Issuance Audit Report
description: SCHEMA-1 typed, content-free pre-issuance audit report. Its load-bearing digest is role-separated: `sha256:` plus lowercase SHA-256 over UTF8(`traigent.agent_certificate.audit_report.v1`) || 0x00 || jcs_v1(this report). It binds build session, client-evidence root, ledger seal, compiler/register identities, and the fixed seven-row support-or-abstention tuple. Unsupported current-v0 IDs B1, REG1, C1, D2, F1, and G3 are structurally abstained; only G1 may have a supported row. A supported row binds the exact claim-material projection using the distinct claim-material role domain, excluding the claim's audit_report_digest entry to avoid a fixed point. The report is built before that entry and before the final unsigned manifest; its digest is referenced by each printed claim when present and by the manifest's leading evidence_digests audit entry even for zero claims. It contains no private content, counts, names, paths, signatures, or self-reference.

AbstentionCodeV0.description: Closed abstention vocabulary: the operational definition of 'unsupported' (C6 Ruling 3(ii), verbatim: 'unregistered claim, missing/versionless verifier, verifier not run or not PASS, missing evidence binding, or prohibited-register violation'). Deliberately the same five values as the first five members of certificate_rejection_v0_schema.json#/definitions/RejectionCodeV0 — tests/test_agent_certificate_v0_schemas.py asserts this enum stays a subset of that one so the two vocabularies cannot drift apart, without coupling this file to the rejection-diagnostic file's broader (network-boundary-specific) vocabulary via $ref. Named AbstentionCodeV0 rather than the more literal 'AbstentionReasonCodeV0' solely to keep this public certification schema clear of an unrelated server-internal Agent-Build-Lifecycle raw-token guard (tests/test_agent_lifecycle_schemas.py's TIER-1 forbidden-substring list) that has no bearing on certificate semantics.

ClaimSupportRowV0.description: One bounded row per registered claim ID (certificate_claims_v0_schema.json#/definitions/ClaimIdV0): either the claim is supported by a populated PASS verifier plus a claim_material_digest binding, or the report records exactly why it abstains. The discriminated if/then keeps a supported row from also carrying an abstention reason and vice versa — the same 'rejection, not downgrade' discipline the claims family itself uses. UPDATED (SCHEMA-1 P1 fix, 2026-08-24): a supported row additionally REQUIRES claim_material_digest, closing the gap where a supported row bound only a claim_id + verifier pair, not the exact printed claim material.

claim_material_digest.description: Present only on a supported row. This is `sha256:` plus lowercase SHA-256 over UTF8(`traigent.agent_certificate.claim_material.v1`) || 0x00 || jcs_v1({claim_id, tier, payload, verifier, evidence_refs}), after removing every audit_report_digest evidence entry while preserving all other evidence order. The report is built before that entry is appended, so this distinct role digest avoids a fixed point. A verifier MUST recompute the exact projection from the printed claim and reject a mismatch.

ClaimSupportRowsV0.description: The canonical FIXED seven-item tuple of ClaimSupportRowV0 (SCHEMA-1 P1 fix, 2026-08-24 — previously a 0..7 bounded array that permitted missing, duplicate, or reordered claim IDs, leaving the promised 'one row per registered claim ID' unenforced). One row per registered claim ID (certificate_claims_v0_schema.json#/definitions/ClaimIdV0), in the pinned order B1, REG1, C1, D2, F1, G1, G3. additionalItems:false plus the exact minItems/maxItems:7 bound make omission, duplication, extension, and reordering schema-invalid; each positional item's own claim_id is const-pinned so a row cannot masquerade as a different claim ID. A claim ID with no printed claim on the certificate MUST still appear here as an abstained row — the tuple always has exactly seven entries.

AuditReportV0.description: The complete pre-issuance audit report. build_session_ref MUST equal certificate.subject.build_session_ref; client_evidence_manifest_root is null when no G1 claim is printed and MUST equal the printed G1 claim's params.manifest_root_digest when G1 is printed; ledger_seal_statement_digest MUST equal certificate.ledger_seal_projection.seal_statement_digest; compiler_register_versions MUST equal the embedded unsigned-manifest document's own compiler_register_versions coverage section exactly — all verifier equality obligations Draft-07 cannot check directly. TRANSMISSION (SCHEMA-1 FINAL fix, 2026-08-24): this record now crosses in full as agent_certificate_v0_schema.json's required top-level `audit_report` field, not merely as an opaque evidence digest — an independent verifier reads it straight off the certificate. Its role-separated digest is ALWAYS the FIRST entry of the signed unsigned manifest's `evidence_digests` projection, including when `claims` is empty; each printed claim additionally carries that same value as its `audit_report_digest` evidence reference. The exact digest is `sha256:` plus lowercase SHA-256 over UTF8(`traigent.agent_certificate.audit_report.v1`) || 0x00 || jcs_v1(this record). A post-signing substitution of the plaintext `audit_report` field therefore changes the signed leading digest and every claim reference, and cannot silently validate.

client_evidence_manifest_root.description: The G1 commitment root this report audited — null when G1 is absent; otherwise certificate_client_evidence_manifest_v0_schema.json#/definitions/ClientEvidenceManifestV0's canonical digest, never the manifest itself. The all-zero sentinel is not a client commitment.
